verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a date-based API versioning scheme (e.g., /crm/2026-09/) under which previous versions keep working until a stated end-of-life date, and v3 path versioning appears in endpoint docs. It also maintains a 'Sunsetted and deprecated APIs' page listing dates and migration targets, and commits to announcing changes on the Developer Changelog. Missing for 10: a concrete guaranteed support/notice window (the docs only promise 'ample notice'), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that the policy is honored in practice.
